h1: Attending Physician Scheduling, Done For You
paragraph: Free your chiefs from complex software. Scheduling Wizard builds your attending schedules from your rules and delivers them in Excel.

cta.title: Get Your Attending Schedules Done Right
cta.description: Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices who have outsourced their scheduling to Scheduling Wizard. Finished schedules in your format, with redrafts through the year included.

faq.answer: Attending physician scheduling software automates the creation and optimization of faculty coverage schedules for residency and fellowship programs. Scheduling Wizard takes this a step further by operating as a fully managed service; your program submits its rules, and our team generates finished, ACGME-compliant attending schedules delivered as Excel spreadsheets. There is no platform for your team to log into or learn.
faq.question: What is attending physician scheduling software and how does it work?

faq.answer: Coverage minimums first, then call equity, contractual obligations, time off and requests, and multiple sites where a group has them. Where the department also trains residents or fellows, the attending schedule has to provide the supervision coverage the ACGME Program Requirements call for, so we build that in alongside the rest. We work from the requirements you tell us apply, and we redraft when something needs to change.
faq.question: What rules do you build an attending schedule around?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard handles schedule creation and optimization, while the platform you already use handles day-to-day schedule access. Many Scheduling Wizard clients continue using the platform they already have alongside the service. SW builds the optimized attending schedule, and programs upload the finished Excel file to their existing publishing platform.
faq.question: Does Scheduling Wizard replace the platform we use now for attending scheduling?

faq.answer: Self-service scheduling software requires someone on your team to learn, operate, and maintain a complex tool year after year. With a managed service like Scheduling Wizard, your program submits rules and receives finished attending schedules. There is no software to learn, no annual retraining when chiefs rotate, and no institutional knowledge lost when a chief leaves.
faq.question: Why is a managed service better than self-service scheduling software for attendings?

faq.answer: Subspecialty-specific ACGME rules are built into the schedule itself. Rather than applying generic compliance logic, our team accounts for the specific duty hour requirements, call structures, and coverage mandates relevant to your program's subspecialty, ensuring the attending schedules it delivers are appropriate for your accreditation context.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard handle subspecialty-specific attending scheduling rules?

faq.answer: Yes. Our team resolves dependencies across attending schedules, block rotations, call schedules, and clinic assignments simultaneously. A change in one schedule type automatically propagates across the others, eliminating the manual cross-referencing and patching that causes conflicts when attending and resident schedules are built separately.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard coordinate attending and resident schedules together?
